title: IKEA Shortcut Button Unused for Thirty Days
app: Aqara, IKEA Tradfri, LIFX, Nanoleaf, Shelly, Zigbee2MQTT, Ecobee, and smart blind motors via vendor clouds, LAN APIs, MQTT bridges, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tradfri:device device_class=button
| stats max(_time) as last_used by device
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_used)/86400,1)
| where days_since>30
| sort - days_since
description: Uses IKEA button events telemetry to monitor how long shortcut buttons have gone unused in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for devices or workflows that are no longer earning their keep, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest IKEA button events data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Shortcut-button table by days since last use.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors how long shortcut buttons have gone unused so you can spot devices or workflows that are no longer earning their keep before it becomes annoying.
